descriptions.text: When you meet a crawler who owns this same item, their name will permanently appear in this enchanted book. You may use the book to exchange messages. You may write your message under their name, and only they will receive it. If you write under your own name, everyone who has your entry will see the message. You may write your message manually or using the messaging interface while turned to the page. One must open the book to read the message, but you will have the option to copy the words. Message will erase on demand, allowing one to write a new note. This book is not retroactively filled with the entries of people you have already met. You must be within close-ish vicinity of them for their name to be added. Works only with crawlers who also own this book.

recap.text: Donut tells Carl she is frightened and does not want to be in charge. Carl opens a Gold Prepotente Box and finds The Filthy Little Crawler's Book of Voodoo. He cannot trade, destroy, or throw away the book, and it returns to his inventory if dropped. The System names it after pin boards at old conventions.

Carl collects an achievement for using a borrowed skill through an ability tattoo, and the System hints the Book of Voodoo can combine them. The book updates with Burcu's map of the surgical theatre and Fireball traps before slamming shut. It splits into two volumes, including Carl's Book of Boom, and contains a note from Asi Hamami to eat a page for a level 10 Lockpick skill. Donut gets A Banquet Fit for a Princess.

Of 989 crawlers, 715 enter the Outreach Guild and do not return. Before they go, they strip their vehicles and trade upgrades. Each crawler uses Milk's method to write a spell into the Voodoo Book for someone else.

beats.headline: Out of a Gold Prepotente Box
beats.text: Donut has just told Carl she is frightened and does not want to be in charge. Carl opens a Gold Prepotente Box and finds a book he cannot trade, cannot destroy and cannot throw away. Drop it and it is back in his inventory. It is named for the pin boards at old conventions, and the System goes out of its way to say that this is the only reason.
beats.gist: Carl opens a Gold Prepotente Box and finds The Filthy Little Crawler's Book of Voodoo.

beats.headline: The AI drops a hint
beats.text: Going through his boxes, Carl collects an achievement for using a borrowed skill through the ability tattoo. The System volunteers, unprompted, that there is a way to put the two together with the book, and then declines to say what it is.
beats.gist: Carl collects an achievement; the System hints at a connection with the Filthy Little Crawler's Book of Voodoo.

beats.headline: A map from Burcu, slammed shut
beats.text: Inside the Madness castle Carl finds the crawler Burcu held beside Architect Houston, and his message to her is refused and logged for the adjutant: planning with a non-member. Then his Book of Voodoo updates with an entry from her. She is drawing a map of the surgical theatre, a line of Xs marked Fireball traps, and starting to write something about Houston, when it slams shut on its own. The accompanying warning: this is still cheating, you clown. Nice try. It is meant for something else.
beats.gist: The Book of Voodoo shows Burcu's map of Fireball traps, then slams shut with a warning.

beats.headline: Carl's Book of Boom
beats.text: Updated with, in the System's words, a metric fuckton of entries, and split into two volumes; the second is Carl's Book of Boom. It should run to almost thirty thousand pages and holds about five hundred, opening near the entry it wants read. Crawler 1,982,122, Asi Hamami, a level 59 fox warrior, has left a note of thanks and a crude red lock and key: eat the page for a level 10 Lockpick skill for five minutes. The crawlers who painted these lose the skills for good. Donut gets a book of her own, A Banquet Fit for a Princess.
beats.gist: The Filthy Little Crawler's Book of Voodoo splits into two volumes, including Carl's Book of Boom.

beats.headline: A spell each, on the way out
beats.text: Of 989 crawlers left, 715 are stepping into the Outreach Guild and not coming back out. On their way they strip their vehicles, trade their upgrades, and, every one of them, use Milk's method to write a spell into the Voodoo Book before they go. The crawlers staying get a thinner field and a thicker book. It is the last thing most of them do in the dungeon, and it is done for somebody else.
beats.gist: Crawlers write spells into the Voodoo Book for others before entering the Outreach Guild.
